title: Yoisaki Kanade — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: carino/carina

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: See? You're shocked, right?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That Tenma is here, not at how cute the uniforms are.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Tenma, what are you doing here?
Oh, yeah... I remember you said you work at a cafe.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehehe, that's right.
This very cafe, as you can see♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Allow me to show you to your table!
Some of your party have already arrived♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, already arrived...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Kanade! It's been a while!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ena and Mizuki told us about your birthday party, and we jumped at the chance to tag along!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see... Thank you for coming.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So you guys invited other people? I assumed it was just going to be us four, like one of our after-parties.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. So, the real reason we started planning a month in advance was so we could invite everyone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, finding a gap in everyone's schedules was tough, but it was worth the work to get a whole bunch of people to join!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
“A whole bunch”...?
Does that mean—

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade! Hello there. What a coincidence, meeting you here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um... Sorry, we actually just got done with the whole reveal...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Oh, I see! That's actually a relief. I didn't have much faith in my acting ability...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Does that mean you're here to see me, too?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes! Asahina reached out to us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for the kind invitation, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're very welcome. I figured you two would want to give your birthday wishes to her in person.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, everyone, if you take your seats I'll get your drink orders in! Then it'll be time for cake!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, hello...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can hardly believe so many people are here for my birthday...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In truth, we almost had three more.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Three more?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Shiraishi and Aoyagi, plus Azusawa. But they're on their trip to the United States with Ena's brother.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's too bad, huh? Still, they said they wanted to give you their well-wishes, so they'll probably message you soon.
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry for the wait! Here's our specialty cake... Birthday edition!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, th-there's sparklers in it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's right! They're special celebratory sparklers♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, our specialty cake is already bigger than the other cakes we sell, but...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Would you believe it? The birthday edition has 1.5 times as much frosting and fruit as an extra bonus!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look at that! It reminds me of a certain Mount Everest.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade. It's time to blow out the candles.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Blow*
Wait, the ones at the back didn't go out...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just a little more...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You can do it, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Blow*
Oh, I got them all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yay♪ Happy birthday, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Minori, Emu, Mafuyu & Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Nene, Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've had people celebrate my birthday before, but...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I'll go and have them cut the cake!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ah... You're on the clock, Tenma. Does that mean you can't have cake with us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: About that... I sure can! Everyone made sure the party timing lined up with the end of my shift.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Once I get the cake cut, I'll clock out, change out of my uniform, and come right back♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, that's good...
Thanks for doing all this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Think nothing of it! I'm really happy I was able to help with the party!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And our cake is super delish, so make sure you have a lot!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I will. Really, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I never thought it could be so lively.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akiyama seemed quite excited for it, so I'm sure you've had a wonderful birthday already. Please let us extend our best wishes, as well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's too bad we couldn't be there for the party, but we'll bring you back plenty of souvenirs from the US!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll be sure to send you pictures of the buildings and scenery we've seen, too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know I already said it once, but happy birthday, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, it made me really happy to host your party at the cafe where I work♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I knew I had to be there the moment I heard about the venue, so I'm glad I was able to join!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. And Ena and the others said they really wanted it to be a lively party, so I'm glad we could make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For them, and for you, Yoisaki! Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And from me too! Happy birthday, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kanade! I'm so glad we got to celebrate with you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika's been in a chipper mood ever since Asahina invited us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: H-Huh? I have...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You have. You sounded really excited when you told me about it, too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, who wouldn't be excited to celebrate a friend's birthday! Of course she'd be all chipper and cheery☆

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm getting a little embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Happy birthday, Ms. Yoisaki. I'm always happy to be of help.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go!
One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Ena, Mizuki & Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kanade.
Happy birthday, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You talked a lot today, Kanade. And not even about music or our work.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! Everyone really wanted to talk to you, after all!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You looked like you were having a lot of fun too, though. Should we do this again for next year's party?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Next year, huh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Works for me! Let's get everyone together and throw a real bash!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for all the birthday wishes.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It feels like every birthday I have, there are more people who want to celebrate it with me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess it goes to show how many people I've been lucky enough to meet...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope I can bring these experiences and feelings through in my music, too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah... To get closer to writing a song that can save someone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I won't ever give up.
